items.evidence: The acceptance test passes. It runs real sandbox lint with the 6 spec probes plus 3 non-normalized path probes and asserts a per-file error line with PlayerView-boundary + REQ-025.1. Holdout in-process lint of src/bots files rejects all of these: applyAction, createHand, STREET_BET_CAP, type HandState, HandState aliased as Action, applyAction aliased as Action, mixed type Action + applyAction, namespace and type-namespace imports, default import, playerView/actWith value imports, mixed type PlayerView + actWith, type Card from cards, and deck/bot-random/seeded-random/hand-evaluator/invariants. Path variants are also rejected: .ts/.js extension, ./../, .././, /./, //, hand/../hand, ../bots/../engine, ../../src/engine, casing variants, nested folders 1-3 deep. All give the REQ-025.1 message.

The acceptance test passes. Holdout rejects these: export {applyAction}, export *, export * as h, export type *, export {default}, export {actWith} and export * from player-view; side-effect imports of hand/player-view, including a dot-segment variant 3 folders deep; empty import {} and import type {}; dynamic import() (Dynamic import message); require() (no-require-imports); and package imports node:fs, fs, type eslint, side-effect vitest, export * from node:fs, node:module createRequire and bare 'src/engine/hand' (relative path message). Gap found: export {} from '../engine/hand' passes lint, and so does the type position import('../engine/hand').HandState. See findings. Neither is in the spec table, and neither can reach hidden runtime state.

The acceptance test passes. Holdout: these all have zero errors: all 5 player-view types, Action/SeatNumber/Street, inline type Action, the alias Action as A, a nested src/bots/styles type import, export type {PlayerView}, JSON and ../advice/recommend. The real src/bots lints clean (npm run lint exit 0). The applyAction import has no boundary error in src/table, src/advice or src/botsx (the rule is scoped to src/bots).

The grep finds none of boundaryProblems/ENGINE_TYPES/test name. git diff --stat main -- src is empty. lint=0, typecheck=0, npm test exit 0. Playtest is byte-identical to main. Determinism rules still fire for Math.random/new Date/Date.now/performance.now in src/advice and src/engine/bot-random.ts and for src/bots, and the resolved config is unchanged outside src/bots.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: bot code cannot name forbidden hand types such as HandState (the spec's cast edge case relies on that). Actual: a type-position import, e.g. `export type H = import('../engine/hand').HandState;` in src/bots, gets no lint error, and tsc resolves it. The old SPEC-09 scan did not catch this either, so it is not a regression, and a type alone cannot reach hidden data because the runtime PlayerView does not carry it.
findings.fix: Optionally add a no-restricted-syntax selector for TSImportType whose argument targets an engine module, so it gets the same allow-list treatment, or a blanket ban in src/bots.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: every side-effect-only load of an engine module from src/bots fails, as `import '../engine/hand'` does. Actual: `export {} from '../engine/hand';` passes lint, because the selector covers ImportDeclaration only. It exposes no bindings.
findings.fix: Optionally extend the side-effect selector to ExportNamedDeclaration with a source and no specifiers.

summary: All 4 SPEC items PASS. npm test passes 1418/0, lint and typecheck are clean, there is no src change, and playtest output is byte-identical to main. Determinism config is unchanged for advice and bot-random. Integrity is clean. Holdout covered 78 cases: 74 as expected, 2 misses are unresolvable specifiers ('../engine/hand/', '../engine', which tsc rejects) that cannot import anything, and 2 are non-blocking gaps (J-1-01 MEDIUM type-position import(), J-1-02 LOW empty re-export). No blocking findings.
